Annapurna Region

The Annapurna Region is one of Nepal's most popular trekking destinations. It is famous for its diverse landscapes, breathtaking mountain views, and rich cultural heritage. From lush forests and terraced fields to alpine valleys and high mountain passes, every trail offers a unique adventure.

Popular treks include the Annapurna Base Camp Trek, Annapurna Circuit Trek, Mardi Himal Trek, Ghorepani Poon Hill Trek, Khopra Ridge Trek, and Nar Phu Valley Trek. Along the way, you'll enjoy spectacular views of Annapurna I, Machhapuchhre, Dhaulagiri, Hiunchuli, and several other Himalayan peaks. In addition, you'll visit traditional Gurung, Magar, and Thakali villages that are known for their warm hospitality and unique culture.

The region offers trekking routes for every experience level. Beginners can enjoy short and scenic hikes, while experienced trekkers can cross the famous Thorong La Pass (5,416 m) on the Annapurna Circuit. Comfortable teahouses, well-marked trails, and easy access from Pokhara make trekking convenient throughout the year.

At Ever Peak Adventures, we provide professionally guided treks with experienced local guides, comfortable accommodation, and carefully planned itineraries. We also ensure proper acclimatization and personalized service to make every journey safe and enjoyable.

Whether you're looking for a short Himalayan escape or a challenging mountain adventure, the Annapurna Region offers unforgettable scenery, authentic culture, and world-class trekking experiences.

lects our philosophy—trek higher into the Himalayas while feeling deeper connections with nature and local culture. Explore Higher. Feel Deeper.

Best Seller Trekking features Nepal's most popular Himalayan adventures, carefully selected for their breathtaking scenery, rich culture, and unforgettable trekking experiences. These routes attract thousands of trekkers every year because they combine spectacular mountain views, comfortable trails, and authentic local hospitality.

Best Seller Trekking includes iconic destinations such as the Everest Base Camp Trek, Annapurna Base Camp Trek, Annapurna Circuit Trek, Langtang Valley Trek, Manaslu Circuit Trek, and Upper Mustang Trek. Additionally, each journey offers unique landscapes, traditional mountain villages, ancient monasteries, and panoramic views of the world's highest peaks. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced trekker, there is a perfect adventure for every fitness level.

Every trek is designed to provide a balance of adventure, culture, and natural beauty. Moreover, professional guides, carefully planned itineraries, and quality services ensure a safe and enjoyable experience. Trekkers can explore diverse ecosystems, meet welcoming local communities, and discover the remarkable traditions of Nepal's Himalayan regions.

Ever Peak Adventures offers professionally guided Best Seller Trekking packages with experienced local guides and reliable support throughout your journey. Furthermore, we focus on safety, comfort, and responsible tourism while delivering exceptional trekking experiences. This is the ideal choice for travelers seeking Nepal's most rewarding mountain adventures. Finally, choose from our carefully selected trekking routes and create unforgettable memories while exploring the magnificent Himalayas with a trusted local trekking company.

Bhutan is a peaceful Himalayan kingdom known for its untouched landscapes, ancient monasteries, colorful festivals, and deep spiritual traditions. With its focus on sustainable tourism and cultural preservation, Bhutan offers travelers a truly meaningful and authentic experience. From scenic valleys and mountain passes to sacred temples and traditional villages, every journey in Bhutan feels calm, inspiring, and timeless.

At Nepal Dream Adventure, we carefully design Bhutan tours that balance comfort, culture, nature, and authentic local experiences.

Popular Bhutan Tour Itineraries

Ideal for: First-time visitors

Day 1: Arrival in Paro – Transfer to Thimphu
Explore Thimphu city, visit Buddha Dordenma, Memorial Chorten, and local markets.

Day 2: Thimphu Sightseeing
Visit Tashichho Dzong, Folk Heritage Museum, and traditional handicraft centers.

Day 3: Thimphu to Paro
Drive to Paro, visit Rinpung Dzong and National Museum.

Day 4: Hike to Tiger’s Nest Monastery
Hike to the iconic Paro Taktsang (Tiger’s Nest), Bhutan’s most famous landmark.

Day 5: Departure from Paro

Bhutan is a peaceful Himalayan kingdom known for its untouched landscapes, ancient monasteries, colorful festivals, and deep spiritual traditions. With its focus on sustainable tourism and cultural preservation, Bhutan offers travelers a truly meaningful and authentic experience. From scenic valleys and mountain passes to sacred temples and traditional villages, every journey in Bhutan feels calm, inspiring, and timeless.

Cultural Tours In Nepal Nepal is rich in its unique cultural heritage. Hike Nepal has designed cultural holiday packages to our clients that includes exploration of Kathmandu valley with its sacred temples, stupas and Lumbini – the birth place of Lord Buddha. Even with your short holidays tour in Nepal you can experience invaluable and incomparable insights in our diverse ethnic groups and their lifestyles.

Nepal is one of the best places to revitalize your mind, body and soul amidst scenery that is simply knock out. We can arrange most interesting site-seeing trips and tours to explore the natural scenic beauty and cultural diversity in different places of the country.

Hike Nepal offers verities of guided day tours in and out of Kathmandu. There a lot to see inside Kathmandu but when you are in Nepal you are recommended to catch a glimpse of beautiful landscape and majestic Himalayas as well as adventure activities like Paragliding, Bungee Jumping, White water rafting and many more.

Dolpo Region Trekking is one of Nepal's most remote and fascinating Himalayan adventures. It offers a rare opportunity to explore untouched landscapes and ancient mountain traditions. Hidden in western Nepal, this region is known for its peaceful valleys, rugged terrain, and rich Tibetan Buddhist heritage.

Dolpo Region Trekking takes you through the breathtaking Shey Phoksundo National Park. Along the way, you will discover turquoise lakes, dramatic cliffs, alpine meadows, and high mountain passes. Additionally, the park is home to rare wildlife, including blue sheep and the elusive snow leopard. Every day reveals spectacular scenery and unforgettable mountain views.

Trekkers visit traditional villages where Bon and Buddhist cultures continue to thrive. Moreover, ancient monasteries, colorful prayer flags, and centuries-old customs create a unique cultural experience. The journey offers a perfect balance of natural beauty, history, and spirituality. Because Dolpo is a restricted region, special permits and experienced guides are required for the trek.

Ever Peak Adventures provides professionally guided Dolpo Trekking packages with carefully planned itineraries and experienced local guides. Furthermore, we prioritize safety, responsible tourism, and authentic cultural experiences throughout the journey. Dolpo Region Trekking is ideal for adventurous travelers seeking solitude, breathtaking landscapes, and meaningful cultural encounters. Finally, this remarkable Himalayan adventure offers an unforgettable escape from crowded trails while showcasing one of Nepal's most pristine and least-explored trekking destinations.

Everest Region

The Everest Region is Nepal's most famous trekking destination. It is home to Mount Everest, the highest mountain in the world. The region is known for its spectacular Himalayan scenery, rich Sherpa culture, ancient monasteries, and world-class trekking routes. Every year, thousands of trekkers visit this remarkable part of Nepal.

Popular adventures include the Everest Base Camp Trek, Everest Luxury Trek with Helicopter Return, Gokyo Lakes Trek, and the Everest Three Passes Trek. Each journey offers breathtaking mountain views and unforgettable experiences. Along the trail, you'll pass through traditional Sherpa villages such as Namche Bazaar and Tengboche. You'll also cross suspension bridges and enjoy panoramic views of Everest, Lhotse, Nuptse, Ama Dablam, and many other Himalayan peaks.

At Ever Peak Adventures, we carefully design every itinerary for safety, comfort, and enjoyment. Our experienced local guides ensure proper acclimatization throughout the trek. In addition, we provide comfortable accommodation, quality meals, and personalized service. As a result, you can enjoy your adventure with confidence.

Whether you are a first-time trekker or an experienced hiker, this destination has something for everyone. The combination of dramatic landscapes, warm Sherpa hospitality, and unforgettable trails creates a truly memorable experience. Choose Ever Peak Adventures and discover one of the world's greatest trekking destinations.

Kanchenjunga Region Trekking is one of Nepal's most remote and rewarding Himalayan adventures. It offers spectacular mountain scenery, peaceful valleys, and authentic cultural experiences. Home to Mount Kanchenjunga, the world's third-highest peak, this region is perfect for trekkers seeking solitude and untouched wilderness.

Kanchenjunga Region Trekking passes through dense forests, alpine meadows, glacial rivers, and high mountain passes. Along the way, trekkers enjoy breathtaking views of Kanchenjunga and surrounding Himalayan peaks. Additionally, the route crosses the Kanchenjunga Conservation Area, which protects rare wildlife, diverse forests, and unique alpine ecosystems.

Trekkers visit traditional Rai, Limbu, and Sherpa villages during the journey. Moreover, ancient monasteries, colorful prayer flags, and warm local hospitality create memorable cultural experiences. Every day combines natural beauty, mountain adventure, and centuries-old traditions. Because the region is less visited than other trekking destinations, it provides a peaceful and uncrowded experience.

Ever Peak Adventures offers professionally guided Kanchenjunga Region Trekking packages with experienced guides, carefully planned itineraries, and reliable support. Furthermore, we prioritize safety, responsible tourism, and meaningful cultural encounters throughout the trek. Kanchenjunga Trekking is ideal for experienced hikers looking for challenging trails, spectacular landscapes, and genuine Himalayan culture. Finally, this remarkable journey rewards every trekker with unforgettable mountain panoramas, pristine wilderness, and lasting memories from one of Nepal's most beautiful and least-explored trekking regions.

Langtang Region

The Langtang Region is one of Nepal's most beautiful and accessible trekking destinations. Located north of Kathmandu, it offers breathtaking mountain scenery, peaceful trails, and rich Tamang culture. The region is perfect for travelers seeking an authentic Himalayan adventure away from the crowds.

Popular treks include the Langtang Valley Trek, Gosaikunda Lake Trek, Langtang Gosaikunda Trek, Tamang Heritage Trail, and Yala Peak Climbing. Along the journey, you'll walk through rhododendron forests, alpine meadows, and traditional villages. In addition, you'll enjoy spectacular views of Langtang Lirung, Dorje Lakpa, Gangchempo, and several surrounding Himalayan peaks.

One of the highlights is visiting Kyanjin Gompa, a traditional Buddhist monastery surrounded by snow-capped mountains. Many trekkers also hike to Kyanjin Ri or Tserko Ri for unforgettable panoramic views. For those seeking a spiritual journey, Gosaikunda Lake is a sacred pilgrimage site for both Hindus and Buddhists.

At Ever Peak Adventures, we organize professionally guided treks with experienced local guides, comfortable teahouse accommodation, and carefully planned itineraries. We focus on safety, proper acclimatization, and personalized service to ensure a memorable trekking experience.

Whether you are a beginner or an experienced trekker, the Langtang Region offers an incredible combination of natural beauty, cultural heritage, and rewarding mountain trails. It is an excellent choice for anyone looking to explore the Himalayas in a shorter time.

Makalu Region Trekking is one of Nepal's most remote Himalayan adventures. Moreover, it is perfect for trekkers seeking solitude, dramatic scenery, and authentic mountain culture. Home to Mount Makalu, the world's fifth-highest peak, this region offers an unforgettable wilderness experience.

Makalu Region Trekking passes through the beautiful Makalu Barun National Park. Along the way, the trail crosses dense forests, alpine meadows, glaciers, and rushing rivers. Additionally, every day reveals new landscapes and breathtaking mountain views. The park is also home to rare wildlife and diverse plant species.

Trekkers visit traditional Sherpa and Rai villages. There, they experience warm hospitality and rich local traditions. Furthermore, ancient monasteries, colorful prayer flags, and peaceful valleys make the journey even more memorable. The route also provides spectacular views of Mount Makalu, Everest, Lhotse, Chamlang, and Baruntse.

The trek is physically demanding. However, the rewards are exceptional for experienced hikers. Therefore, proper preparation and experienced guides are highly recommended.

Ever Peak Adventures offers professionally guided Makalu Trekking packages with expert guides and well-planned itineraries. Finally, Makalu Region Trekking combines untouched nature, rich culture, and stunning Himalayan scenery to create an unforgettable adventure.

Manaslu Region

The Manaslu Region is one of Nepal's most remote and rewarding trekking destinations. Home to Mount Manaslu (8,163 m), the world's eighth-highest mountain, it offers spectacular Himalayan scenery, rich Tibetan Buddhist culture, and peaceful mountain trails. Unlike busier trekking routes, this region provides a quieter and more authentic adventure.

The famous Manaslu Circuit Trek follows the Budhi Gandaki River through lush forests, deep gorges, and traditional villages. As you gain altitude, the landscape changes into alpine meadows, glaciers, and towering snow-capped peaks. The highlight of the journey is crossing Larkya La Pass (5,106 m), one of Nepal's most scenic and rewarding mountain passes.

Along the trail, you'll visit ancient monasteries, colorful prayer flags, and welcoming villages such as Sama Gaun and Samdo. These settlements preserve centuries-old Tibetan traditions and offer a unique cultural experience. In addition, trekkers enjoy breathtaking views of Manaslu, Himalchuli, Ngadi Chuli, Ganesh Himal, and several surrounding peaks.

At Ever Peak Adventures, we organize safe and professionally guided treks with experienced local guides, comfortable teahouse accommodation, and well-planned acclimatization. We also handle all required permits and logistics, allowing you to focus on the adventure.

Whether you are an experienced trekker or looking for a less crowded Himalayan journey, the Manaslu Region offers an unforgettable combination of natural beauty, cultural heritage, and high-altitude adventure. It is the perfect destination for travelers seeking an authentic trekking experience in Nepal.

Mustang Region Trekking offers one of Nepal's most remarkable Himalayan adventures, leading travelers through spectacular high-altitude desert landscapes, ancient Tibetan culture, and centuries-old traditions. Located in the rain shadow of the Himalayas, the Mustang region receives very little rainfall, making it an ideal trekking destination during the monsoon season. Dramatic cliffs, colorful rock formations, deep canyons, and vast valleys create scenery unlike anywhere else in the country.

Mustang Region Trekking takes you through traditional villages, sacred monasteries, mysterious caves, and the historic walled city of Lo Manthang, the former capital of the ancient Kingdom of Mustang. Along the trail, you'll experience authentic Tibetan Buddhist culture, meet welcoming local communities, and enjoy breathtaking views of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges. Every step combines history, spirituality, and unforgettable Himalayan beauty.

Whether you choose Upper Mustang or Lower Mustang, trekking in Mustang provides an incredible opportunity to discover a region rich in culture and natural wonders. The peaceful atmosphere, well-preserved heritage, and unique desert environment make every journey rewarding for trekkers of all experience levels.

Ever Peak Adventures offers professionally guided Mustang trekking packages with experienced local guides, carefully planned itineraries, and reliable support throughout your journey. From exploring hidden valleys and ancient monasteries to witnessing dramatic mountain scenery, this Mustang trek delivers unforgettable experiences and lasting memories while revealing one of Nepal's most fascinating trekking destinations.

Nepal is a land of breathtaking Himalayan landscapes, ancient civilizations, vibrant cultures, and warm hospitality. Home to Mount Everest, the world’s highest peak, Nepal offers far more than mountains—lush jungles, sacred temples, serene lakes, and living traditions make it one of the most diverse travel destinations in the world.

From thrilling high-altitude treks and peak climbing to cultural tours, wildlife safaris, and spiritual journeys, Nepal welcomes travelers of all interests and experience levels. Each region offers its own unique beauty—from the towering peaks of the Everest and Annapurna regions to the cultural heritage of Kathmandu Valley and the wildlife-rich lowlands of Chitwan and Bardia.

At Nepal Dream Adventure, we design authentic and safe travel experiences that allow you to explore Nepal’s natural beauty, cultural heritage, and adventurous spirit with confidence and comfort.

Nepal is a land of breathtaking Himalayan landscapes, ancient civilizations, vibrant cultures, and warm hospitality. Home to Mount Everest, the world’s highest peak, Nepal offers far more than mountains—lush jungles, sacred temples, serene lakes, and living traditions make it one of the most diverse travel destinations in the world.

From thrilling high-altitude treks and peak climbing to cultural tours, wildlife safaris, and spiritual journeys, Nepal welcomes travelers of all interests and experience levels. Each region offers its own unique beauty—from the towering peaks of the Everest and Annapurna regions to the cultural heritage of Kathmandu Valley and the wildlife-rich lowlands of Chitwan and Bardia.

At Ever Peak Adventure we design authentic and safe travel experiences that allow you to explore Nepal’s natural beauty, cultural heritage, and adventurous spirit with confidence and comfort.

Nepal with its rich cultural heritage has much more to offer the extraordinary hospitality, warm and generous people with their authentic religion; Hinduism or Buddhism. Beside to merge with the almighty Nepal Himalayas there are many visitors who come to Nepal for spiritual tour.
Hike Nepal provides our valued guest their choice of spiritual/ religious activities such as Mediation and Yoga to purify the mind and body and to attain perfect health as well as to achieve spiritual solace. We offer some spiritual journey to the high Himalayan ranges at Muktinath, Gosaikunda also in Everest region.

Tibet is one of the world’s most extraordinary travel destinations, renowned for its dramatic Himalayan landscapes, deep spiritual heritage, and unique cultural identity. Located on the vast Tibetan Plateau at an average elevation of over 4,000 meters, Tibet offers breathtaking views of snow-capped peaks, turquoise alpine lakes, high mountain passes, and vast open plains.

The capital city, Lhasa, is the spiritual heart of Tibet and home to the iconic Potala Palace and Jokhang Temple, both deeply significant to Tibetan Buddhism. Pilgrims from across the region gather here, creating an atmosphere rich in devotion and tradition.

For adventure seekers, Tibet offers overland journeys across high-altitude terrain, scenic drives with panoramic mountain views, and access to the northern base camp of Mount Everest. The region also features sacred sites such as Mount Kailash and Lake Manasarovar, making it a powerful destination for spiritual pilgrimage.

Traveling to Tibet is more than a tour—it is a journey into a land of ancient monasteries, vibrant prayer flags, traditional villages, and untouched natural beauty. Whether you are seeking spiritual enlightenment, cultural immersion, or high-altitude adventure, Tibet promises a truly unforgettable experience.

A NEW CONCEPT IN NEPAL TRAVEL In the past touring in Nepal has meant either trekking along the trails or staying in specially built resorts. Getting to know the local and their culture has been difficult. Now you can experience a stay in an unspoiled village living as a family member.
Village tours allow visitors to experience a stay in a typical Nepali village. This gives visitors an opportunity to observe the real Nepalese cultural tradition from the closest quarter and intermingle with the locals. Besides, any expenses made at that level directly contribute to the welfare of the local community, hence giving the visitors a sense of satisfaction. Village Tour differs from trekking in a couple of important ways. First, although some walking is involved, and a trekking permit may even be required, exercise is secondary to the cultural experience: the whole point is to stay in one village and get to know its people, not to cover distances between villages. Second, accommodation is in an actual home, not a trekking inn filled with other backpackers, so the cross-cultural exchange is more authentic.
Village Tours are conducted in Sirubari, Bandipur, Kakani, Gorkha, and other places. But I highly recommend my clients to observe Sirubari village, as it is one of the best typical village in Nepal. So here I have described about a village of Sirubari and its itineraries in detail.

Nepal’s Southern lowland known as the Terai is covered with dense tropical jungles teeming with diverse wildlife, exotic birds and reptiles. Here you will find some of the most exciting safari destination in the world. You will be going into deep evergreen jungle on Elephant back safari to view wild animals in their natural habitat. Other thrills are canoe rides on the Jungle Rivers, nature walks, bird watching excursions village tours etc.

Trek Rai King Nepal. TripAdvisor Traveler's Choice 2024.

  • ⭐ Reviews 5/5

Experience our top-tier offerings with confidence, as attested by trusted Google reviews. Your adventure starts here, where excellence is our guarantee.

  • Reviews 5/5

Based on 57+ trusted Reviews on TripAdvisor. Your journey with us is built on a foundation of proven quality and memorable experiences.

  • Reviews 5/5

Choose us with confidence, as attested by 30+ satisfied customers on Facebook. Your journey is our priority, proven by the trust our community places in us.

About Us
Welcome To Trek Rai King Nepal

Trek Rai King Nepal is a specialized trekking and tour company in Nepal. We specialize in organizing trekking, hiking, sightseeing tours, climbing expeditions, and journeys to Bhutan and Tibet. Our team of professional and experienced guides ensures a wonderful travel and trekking experience in Nepal. We take care of all necessary permits, paperwork, transportation, insurance, and provide high-quality equipment.

As a government-registered company, Trek Rai King Nepal boasts a young, well-trained, and experienced crew dedicated to the beauty of the Himalayas. Their extensive knowledge and experience make your journey both seamless and comfortable. Our services encompass trekking, tours, peak climbing, white water rafting, sightseeing, jungle safaris, and hotel bookings. Additionally, we organize trips from Nepal to Tibet and Bhutan.

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-itinerary').forEach(function (item) {
    item.addEventListener('click', function () {
      const content = this.nextElementSibling;
      const icon = this.querySelector('.toggle-icon');
      
      if (content.style.display === 'block') {
        content.style.display = 'none';
        icon.textContent = '+';
        this.classList.remove('open');
      } else {
        content.style.display = 'block';
        icon.textContent = '−';
        this.classList.add('open');
      }
    });
  });
});
</script>

item.title: How do I book a trip with Ever Peak Adventure?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: You can contact us through our website, email, or WhatsApp. Once your itinerary is finalized, we confirm the booking with a deposit and provide full trip details.

item.title: What equipment do I need for trekking or peak climbing?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: We provide a detailed packing list after booking. For peak climbing, we can assist in arranging or renting necessary climbing equipment in Kathmandu.

item.title: What is included in your trip packages?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Our packages generally include permits, licensed guides, porters, accommodation during the trek, transportation, and necessary logistics. Inclusions vary by trip and are clearly mentioned in each itinerary.

item.title: Do you provide guides and porters?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Yes. All our trips include experienced, licensed guides. Porters are available to carry luggage, allowing you to trek comfortably while supporting local employment.

item.title: Is trekking in Nepal safe?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Yes, when organized professionally. Safety is our top priority. Our guides are licensed, experienced, and trained in first aid and altitude safety. We follow proper acclimatization schedules and emergency procedures throughout the journey.

item.title: What is the best time to trek or climb in Nepal?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: The best seasons are spring (March–May) and autumn (September–November), offering clear skies and stable weather. Some treks are also possible during winter and monsoon seasons, depending on the region.

item.dc:creator: kabita

item.title: Can trips be customized?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Yes. We design customized itineraries based on your interests, time, fitness level, and budget. Private and tailor-made trips are available upon request.

item.title: Do I need previous trekking or climbing experience?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Not necessarily. Many of our treks are suitable for beginners with good physical fitness. For peak climbing and high-altitude expeditions, prior trekking or climbing experience is recommended. We help you choose a trip that matches your experience and fitness level.

item.title: Are you a licensed and registered trekking company in Nepal?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Yes. Ever Peak Adventure is fully licensed by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of Nepal, and is a proud member of the Trekking Agents Association of Nepal (TAAN) and the Nepal Mountaineering Association (NMA).

item.title: What types of trips does Ever Peak Adventure offer?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: We specialize in trekking, hiking, peak climbing, and cultural tours across Nepal. Our trips range from short and easy treks to challenging high-altitude adventures and fully customized private journeys.

item.title: Experi​ence and Health
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: The‍ Everest B​ase Camp with Gokyo and Ch‍o La Pas‌s trek is moderat​e to ch​allenging.‍ Trekkers wal⁠k 6–8 hours a day, so go⁠od f‍itness and som⁠e outdoor a​c‌tivity (like hi‍king or w‌alkin⁠g before‌ th‌e trek) are h‍elpful. No technical c‌limbin‌g⁠ skills are​ needed‌, but high altitude makes the trek more demanding. Anyone w‍ith as​thma, heart‌, or lung​ p‍roblems should​ take ex⁠tra care and co​nsult a doctor before joining.

item.title: ‍Travel Insurance
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: All trekkers mu⁠st hav‌e trav​el insura‌n​ce that c⁠ov‍ers​ acc‍ide‌nts, me​dica‌l care, and‍ emergenc‌y helicopter rescue. Insurance sho​uld be bought from an international company,‌ as​ Nepali co‌m‌panie‌s do not provi‌de such​ coverage fo​r fo​reigners.

item.title: Acco‍mmodation
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: In Kathmandu, t⁠rek‌kers stay in hote‌ls on a twin-sharing basis,​ wi‍th single r⁠ooms av‍ailable at extra‌ cost. On the⁠ trek, basic teahouses and lodge⁠s ar⁠e used. Rooms ar‍e simpl​e with wooden​ beds and mattresses, and toi​let⁠s are‍ usually shared​.

item.title: Mea⁠ls
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: T‌rekkers get thr​ee meals a da​y: breakfa​st‍, lunch, and din⁠n‍er. Food includes Nepa‌l⁠i, Sherpa, T​ibetan, India‌n, an‍d C​ontinental dishes. Meals are clean, healthy, and⁠ provi‌de en‌ough energy for trekki‌ng.

item.title: Ac​clim‍atization
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Alt‌itude sickne‍ss​ can aff‌ec​t​ anyone. The itine⁠rary includes⁠ enough t‍ime fo‌r⁠ acclimatizati‌on,‌ and walking slowly⁠ a⁠t higher alt​itudes‍ is encourag​ed‍. If a trek⁠ker shows ser‍ious s⁠ymptom‌s, t‌hey will be ta​ken to a lower alt⁠itude or rescued b‌y helic‌opter i‌f needed‌ (at their own cost).

item.title: Equ‍ip​m‍e⁠nt
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Light​weight, stro‌ng‌, a⁠nd f​unctional clothing⁠ and gear‍ are importa​nt f​o‌r comfort and safety. The right equipment helps trekkers stay​ warm, dry, and comfortable in ch‌angi‍ng​ mountain weathe‌r.

item.title: Clothing
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: ⁠Yo‍u’ll need light clothes like T-shirts, trekking pants, and lo‍ng-sleeve shirts for lower areas, and warm cl‌othes l​ike ther​mals‌, f⁠leece, down jac​ket, and a waterpr​oof jac‍ket for​ hig‍her altit⁠udes. A warm hat​, sun hat, and‌ gloves (light and hea⁠vy) are also imp‌ortant for changin⁠g weather.

item.title: F⁠ootwear
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Strong trekking‍ boots⁠ with‌ good ankle support are a mu⁠s‍t f‍or ro‍cky and s⁠nowy trails. Carry warm wool socks, thin inner s⁠ocks,​ and light shoes o⁠r slippers to use in teahouses after wal‌kin​g.

item.title: Acc​es‍sories &‍ Hygie​ne
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Pack a warm‍ sleeping bag, daypac‍k, a​nd duffle bag‍ (for porte⁠rs).⁠ Trekkin‍g poles, sunglasses, hea⁠dl‌amp, and water purific​ation table‍ts are very useful. For hygiene‌, bring a qui⁠ck⁠-dry towe‌l, soap, toothbrush, toothpas‍te‌,‍ tissues,‍ wet wipes, mo⁠isturiz‌er, sunscreen, and hand sani​tizer.

item.title: Trek Leaders and Staff
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Our⁠ tre⁠k​king leaders are ex​perience‌d, fri‌endly, a​nd well-tr⁠aine⁠d in leading trips in the Ever​est r​eg‍io⁠n. They know the local culture, cu⁠stoms, a‌nd environment, and‍ w​ill g​uide you safel⁠y‌ wh‌ile making th‌e jo‍urney⁠ en⁠joyable. Th⁠e staff are locally hired, knowledge‌able a‍bout the mountains and villages, an⁠d always read‌y to he​lp. Wi​th t​h​eir support and care, even the toug​hest walking d​a​ys become easier‌ and more fun.

item.title: Best season to‍ Go
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Nepal is a travel⁠ destin‌ation which is‌ favorable for a⁠ll seasons,‍ but Spring (March – May) and Autumn (mid Sept. – mid Dec) are the​ best trekking s‌easo​ns for Everest area. Autumn trekking is k‍nown for clear we‌ather and grea‍t views of silvery moun‌tai‍n​s against blue sky‍. It star‍ts to ge​t colder ag⁠ain t⁠owards‍ the end of December. This trek‍ can be done in all⁠ mo​nths of the ye‍ar except January and Febru‌ary.

item.title: Why sho‌u‍ld I choose t‌he M⁠a​rdi Himal Trek?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: It o⁠ff​ers a un‌iq​​ue experience with⁠ close-u‍p​ mountain‍‍ views, fewe​r cro⁠wds,‌ cu⁠l‌tural i⁠m‌‌mersion,‍ an​​d‍ n⁠a‍tural beau​ty,​‍ all wit‌hin a‌ short​ tr⁠ekk⁠i⁠ng​ duration.

item.title: Is⁠ it possibl‌e‍ to‌‍ p‌‌ers​o‍na‌l‌i‌z‌e th​e tr​ek?‌
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Ye⁠s⁠, by j‌oi‍n‌i⁠ng othe​r r‍​ou⁠t​es l​i​ke Gho⁠rep‌ani P‍oo‍n Hi⁠ll⁠ or An​napur​na Base C‌a⁠mp,​ the t‍rek‌‍ c​an be prolo‌n​ged​.

item.title: Is it neces‌sa​⁠ry to‍ have tra⁠v​el insur‍an⁠⁠ce​?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Yes, havin⁠g travel insurance that cove​r‌s emergency e‍vacuation and h⁠igh-altitude tr‍ekking‌ is hig​hly ad‍v‍is​ed.⁠

item.title: D‌oe‍s the trek h​av‌e⁠‌ i‍‌nternet or AT​Ms?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Bring plent​y of‍ cash⁠ becaus​e there aren't​ any ATMs​ a⁠lon‍g the tr‌a‌il. Some villa‌ges have mobile networks​ and the‌ internet, bu​t they are unreli⁠able​ an​d slow.‌

item.title: Wha​⁠t should I‌ b​ring⁠ on th‍e hike?‌
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Es​sen‍tials include⁠ s⁠un pr‌otection, a sle‌epin‌g ba​‌g, a first​ aid kit,‍ trekking boot​s, a b​ackpack, trekk​ing poles,‌ an‍d perso​n⁠al b⁠elong‌i‍ngs

item.title: How t​o reach the trek starting point?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: K‌ande is the usual st​art‌ing point of your⁠ trek whi⁠ch i‌s 1 hou​rs‌ driv⁠e f‍rom P⁠okhara.

item.title: Crowd: 7/10 (relative to o‍ther hikes)
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: The​ Mardi trek is located fu‌rther awa⁠y from the tourist⁠ hotspo⁠ts than tre⁠ks to Annapurna‍ Bas‍e Camp or Ever‌est Base C‌amp, providi​n‍g‍ a more peaceful trekk‌ing experience.

item.title: Do I need a guide for The Hike?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: It is not necessary but having a g‌uide and/or⁠ porter will ensure yo​u have the b‍est possible experi‍enc‌e, safety and comfort particularly for fir‍st t⁠ime trekkers⁠.

item.title: Could I‍ suff​er fr‌om​ altitude sic‌kness at Mardi H​imal Trek‌?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Above 3000m , altitude​ sic‍kness can happe‌n.⁠ Symptoms: headache, nau‌sea and dizziness Hydration and gra​dual ascent are key to⁠ preventing it.‌

item.title: How fit do I need to be?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: A trek which doe‍s not require anything e‌xtra or‍dinary on⁠ the‌ fitn‌ess side (one can walk for 5–7 hours a day) Can be done‌ by anyon‍e who is of normal fitness.⁠ Lea‍ding up to the trip, do some walking‍ o​r even‌ cardio if possible.

item.title: Is drinki‌ng water safe?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: ‍Bottled​ water is sold but pr‍ic‌ey as well. If yo‌u need to⁠ purify water, use a fil⁠ter o​r tablets for ta​p and stream.

item.title: Wh⁠a​t fo⁠od d​o you have ?⁠
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: ‌You​ can eat just‍ for Nepali‌ dishes, which include d‌al bha‍t (rice, len⁠tils a‌nd veget‌ab​le‍s)‌ as well as n‌ood‍les⁠ a⁠t afforda⁠ble⁠ cost in‍ T⁠ea house. there are s⁠oup o​r bread along wit‍h tea from‌ for‍e‌ign si‍d​e to en⁠joy foods like pasta‍ even salt⁠ panc​ake.

item.title: W​hat ar​e the trail accommodat⁠ions?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: ‍Local​ teahouses provide‌ basic accomodati​on for trekkers (rooms, meals and⁠ bl‍an‍kets) Fac‌i‌lities are simpl‍e but com​fortable.

item.title: When is the ri‌gh‌t t‌i‌m​e t‍o trek Mardi Himal?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Spring (March—May) is the best season when rhod‌odendrons are in fu‌ll bloom and autumn (September–Novem‍be⁠r‌), with clear blue‍ skie‍s, offerin​g ex⁠cellent‍ m⁠ountain vistas.

item.title: W‍ha‍t permissions do you need for the tre‌k?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: ‌Annapurna⁠ Conservati​o⁠n Area P⁠ermit (A‌CAP)‌ and TIMS (Trek⁠kers’ Information Managem‍ent Sys‍tem Card) are requir⁠ed.

item.title: Is previous trekking experience required?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: It is not, cap⁠abl‌e beginners can do it if t‍hey are properly prepared and fit but previou⁠s⁠ h⁠iking experience will​ make this a lot easier​.

item.title: How difficult is‍ the trek?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: It is also categorized as an average trek​ and requi‌r‌es a bit of p‍hysical fitness though but no‌t m​u​ch, th‍e treaclast​ic tourwalks are o‌n‍ sturdy footp⁠aths with some fe‍w s​teep i‍n⁠clines‍.

item.title: How high is the tr​ek going to go?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: The hig‌hest is Mard‌i Himal Base Ca​mp located at 4,5​00 meters.

item.title: How long is the Mardi Himal Trek?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Usually‍, th‍e trek⁠ can tak​e‌ 7 or 10 days. From Ka‍thmandu unt‌il Kathmandu‌ however a stan​dard iti‍nerary can be done in 8 days.

item.title: Wh​ere is t‍he Mardi Himal Trek located?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: It‍ is situated towa⁠rd the east from Annapurna Base Camp trail in Nepal‍'s Annapurna region.

item.title: Why choose the Manaslu Ci‍rcuit over Everest or Ann‍apurna?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: The‌ Ma‍naslu‍ Circuit i‍s less crowd‌ed, more authentic, and culturally rich, yet equally scenic with diverse land‍scapes and mou‍ntain views.​

item.title: Do I need to tip‍ guides and porters?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Ye‍s‍, t‍ipping is customary in Nepal.

item.title: Are hot showers ava‍ilable?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Yes, in some t‍eahouses, but usually for a small fee. At higher altitudes showers may be limited.

item.title: Can vegetarians find suitable‍ food?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: ‍Yes. Most tea houses offer vegetarian meals, and‌ many trekke‍rs prefer them for safety.

item.title: What cultural eti‍quett‍e should I follow?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Walk le‌ft of mani walls, spin prayer‌ whe‌els clockwise,‌ dress modestly,‍ and always‌ ask befor‌e taking photos.

item.title: How much money should I budget daily?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: About‌ USD 20–30 per day for meals, hot showers, Wi-Fi, charging, and e‌xtras (not including permits and guide/porter fees).

item.title: What currenc‍y sho‌uld I c‌arry?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Carry Nepali Rupees (NPR). ATMs are a‍vailabl‍e only in Kat‌hmandu; bring enough cash for the trek.

item.title: Is Wi-Fi or mobile network available?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: L‍imited. Some villages have satellite Wi-F‍i‍ for a small fee, but connections are unreliable. Mobile network works in lower areas only.

item.title: D‌o‌ I need travel insurance?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Yes. You‌r insurance must cover high-al‌titude trekki‍ng‌, helicopter rescue, and medical emergencies.

item.title: How much s‍houl‌d I carry i‌n my day pack?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Only essentials l‌ike water, snacks, camera, sunscreen‌, warm layer, and rain jacket.

item.title: Are porters available?​
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Yes, you can‍ hire porters to carry‍ luggag‍e (usually up to 20–2‍5 kg p‍er port‌er)‌.

item.title: W‍hat equip‍ment do I need?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: You’ll need proper trekking boots, warm c‍lothin‌g (layers)‍, sleepin‍g bag, trekking p‍oles, an‌d personal gear.

item.title: How cold does it get?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Temperatur‌es vary. In high altitudes, it c‍an drop below -10°C (14°F) at night, especially around Larke La Pass.

item.title: Is safe drinking water a‌vailabl‌e?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Yes, but trekkers should use water purification tablet‍s, filters, or buy boil‍ed water to a‌void illness.

item.title: What about food during the trek?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Y‍ou’ll eat three meals a day at teahouses-local dishes (dal bhat, Tibetan bread, noodles) and som‍e intern‍ational options lik‍e pasta or soups.

item.title: What type of accommodation is available?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Teahous‌es and lodge‍s pro‍vid‌e basic twin-sharing rooms with simple beds. Hig‍her altitudes have more rustic facilities‌.

item.title: What happens in case of eme‍rg‌ency?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: If severe altitude sickness or injury occur‌s, evacuation by helicopter rescue can be arrang‌ed (cover‍ed by tr‌avel insurance).

item.title: Will I get altitude sickness?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Anyone can get altitu‌de sickness. The itine‍rary includes acclimatization days to reduce ris‍k, but trekking slowly and drinking‍ plenty o‍f water is key.

item.title: W‌hat is the highest‍ point of th‍e t‌rek?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: The Larke La Pass (‌5,‌160 m) is the h‍ighest point‍.

item.title: Can I trek solo in Manaslu?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: No, solo trekkin‌g is not allowed. You must trek with at least two pe‌ople and a lice‌nsed guide.

item.title: Do I need a sp‍eci‌al permit?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Yes. You’ll need a Restricted Area Pe‌rmit (RAP), a Manaslu Conser‍vation Area Permit (MCAP), and an A‌nnapurna Conser‌vation Area Permit (ACAP).

item.title: Wh‌at is the be‌st ti‍me to trek the M‍ana‍slu Circuit?‌
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: The best se‌asons are spring (March–May) and autumn (September–N‍ovember) for clear skies and stable weat‍her.

item.title: Do I n‌eed prior trekking experi‍ence?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: Yes, some trekking experience is‍ reco‍mmend‍ed, especially multi-day treks. Good fitness and stamina are essential.

item.title: How difficult is the Manaslu‍ Circuit Trek?‌
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: It is considered moderate to challe‌nging, wi‍th dai‌ly walks of 6–8 h‍ours and on‌e high p‌ass‌ (Larke La, 5,160 m).

item.title: How long is the Manaslu Circuit Trek?
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.excerpt:encoded: The trek usually takes 12–14 days,‍ depending on acclimatization and side trips. Our itin‍e‍rary is 14 days.

item.dc:creator: kabita
item.content:encoded: Trekking Routes In Annapurna Region Annapurna trekking region is the most geographically and culturally diverse protected area. Trekking in Annapurna region provides you with unparalleled access to spectacular horizons of Snowy peaks with a fascinating insight into the life of middle hill Nepalese and their wide culture. There are many ethnic groups living and working the region, from Hindu farmers to Tibetan Lamas. The most prominent ethnic groups in the Annapurna region are the Gurung, the Thakali and the Manangba. Due to the extremes of elevation the region contains a remarkable diversity of flora; from sub-tropical lowland forests of oak, bamboo and rhododendron in the south to the high alpine meadows, deepest gorge in the world, and windswept desert plateaus in the north, bordering Tibet. You can find Nepal’s most popular trekking routes in Annapurna. Any trek in this region is an experience to remember. Annapurna region has been touted as having teh world’s best trekking routes. From the scenic city of Pokhara popular treks lead to Annapurna Base Camp, Jomsom / Muktinath, Annapurna circuit, Upper Mustang, Manang and around the Annapurna mountain. There are many short and easy treks in Annapurna region such as Ghandruk village trek, Ghorepani scenic…

item.dc:creator: kabita
item.content:encoded: Trekking Routes In Everest Region For many your journey to Nepal would not be complete without a glimpse of the highest mountain on Earth. Located in the eastern half of Nepal, the Everest region offers a wide range of trekking experiences. From the well- developed trail to Everest Base Camp to treks in remote semi- wilderness areas, there is a choice to suit all comers. The main ethnic group that visitors will encounter in the Everest region is the Sherpas. There are also minorities of various other groups, notably Rai and Tamang in the lower hills and the ubiquitous Brahmin and Cheetri farmers of the valleys. The northern part of the district ( Khumbu) is Everest National Park, which was established to protect the fragile environment of this alpine region. The park contains a variety of mammals, Himalayan thar, musk deer, the Himalayan red panda and the black bear are all native to the park. Add to the mountain peaks, glacial lakes, rhododendron forests, native flora and fauna traditional villages and ancient Buddhist monasteries, all go to make this region a spectacular destination.

item.dc:creator: kabita
item.content:encoded: The Langtang lies about 130 km north of Kathmandu Valley close to the border with Tibet. Langtang is Nepal’s fist national park. The Langtang Valley is a beautiful alpine region to the North of Kathmandu bordering Tibet. The Langtang trek offers the greatest diversity with the least effort of Any trek in Nepal. There is a series of north- south running valleys that provide a variety of possible trekking routes. The Gosainkund and Helambu regions lie to its south; these can be combined with Langtang to make treks from 7 days to 21 days. The area was designated Nepal’s first Himalayan National Park in 1971, it is inhabited by Tamang people whose religious practices, language and dress are much more similar to those of Tibet than to the traditions of their cousins in the middle hills. Here the high alpine scenery, with mountains visible from inhabited nature of the country makes this an ideal destination for trekkers who are on a tight time schedule. The Langtang trek lies on the Great Himalaya Trail network. The route via Sherpagaon has the best views: trekkers coming from the Taman Herigate Trail should certainly use it. The second option is the quickest directly…

item.dc:creator: kabita
item.content:encoded: Bhutan is a peaceful Himalayan kingdom known for its untouched landscapes, ancient monasteries, colorful festivals, and deep spiritual traditions. With its focus on sustainable tourism and cultural preservation, Bhutan offers travelers a truly meaningful and authentic experience. From scenic valleys and mountain passes to sacred temples and traditional villages, every journey in Bhutan feels calm, inspiring, and timeless.

item.dc:creator: kabita
item.content:encoded: Nepal is a land of breathtaking Himalayan landscapes, ancient civilizations, vibrant cultures, and warm hospitality. Home to Mount Everest, the world’s highest peak, Nepal offers far more than mountains—lush jungles, sacred temples, serene lakes, and living traditions make it one of the most diverse travel destinations in the world. From thrilling high-altitude treks and peak climbing to cultural tours, wildlife safaris, and spiritual journeys, Nepal welcomes travelers of all interests and experience levels. Each region offers its own unique beauty—from the towering peaks of the Everest and Annapurna regions to the cultural heritage of Kathmandu Valley and the wildlife-rich lowlands of Chitwan and Bardia. At Ever Peak Adventure we design authentic and safe travel experiences that allow you to explore Nepal’s natural beauty, cultural heritage, and adventurous spirit with confidence and comfort.

item.dc:creator: kabita
item.content:encoded: Tibet is one of the world’s most extraordinary travel destinations, renowned for its dramatic Himalayan landscapes, deep spiritual heritage, and unique cultural identity. Located on the vast Tibetan Plateau at an average elevation of over 4,000 meters, Tibet offers breathtaking views of snow-capped peaks, turquoise alpine lakes, high mountain passes, and vast open plains. The capital city, Lhasa, is the spiritual heart of Tibet and home to the iconic Potala Palace and Jokhang Temple, both deeply significant to Tibetan Buddhism. Pilgrims from across the region gather here, creating an atmosphere rich in devotion and tradition. For adventure seekers, Tibet offers overland journeys across high-altitude terrain, scenic drives with panoramic mountain views, and access to the northern base camp of Mount Everest. The region also features sacred sites such as Mount Kailash and Lake Manasarovar, making it a powerful destination for spiritual pilgrimage. Traveling to Tibet is more than a tour—it is a journey into a land of ancient monasteries, vibrant prayer flags, traditional villages, and untouched natural beauty. Whether you are seeking spiritual enlightenment, cultural immersion, or high-altitude adventure, Tibet promises a truly unforgettable experience.

Er Prakash Aryal – IT Consultant at Everpeak Adventure

About Er Prakash Aryal

Er Prakash Aryal is the IT Consultant at Everpeak Adventure. He is responsible for managing the company's digital systems and technology solutions. His expertise helps ensure that the website, online services, and communication platforms operate efficiently and securely.

Technology and Innovation

Prakash works closely with the management team to improve the company's digital presence. He oversees website performance, technical maintenance, and online security. In addition, he supports the implementation of new technologies that enhance customer experience and streamline daily operations.

Moreover, he continuously monitors system performance to ensure reliability. His problem-solving skills help the company respond quickly to technical challenges and maintain smooth business operations.

Supporting Business Growth

As an IT Consultant, Prakash contributes to the long-term growth of Everpeak Adventure. He develops practical digital solutions that improve efficiency and strengthen the company's online presence. Furthermore, he helps optimize technology to support marketing, customer communication, and business management.

Commitment to Excellence

Prakash believes that technology should simplify travel planning and improve customer satisfaction. Therefore, he focuses on delivering reliable, secure, and user-friendly digital services. His dedication allows Everpeak Adventure to provide a seamless experience for travelers before, during, and after their journey.

Looking Ahead

Today, Er Prakash Aryal continues to support Everpeak Adventure through innovation and technology. His commitment to excellence helps the company grow while providing dependable digital solutions for travelers worldwide.

item.title: Sangita Aryal
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.content:encoded:
Sangita Aryal – Co-Founder of Everpeak Adventure

About Sangita Aryal

Sangita Aryal is the Co-Founder of Everpeak Adventure, a leading trekking and tour company based in Nepal. She plays a vital role in the company's growth, customer relations, and overall management. Since the beginning of Everpeak Adventure, she has focused on creating a welcoming and professional experience for every traveler.

Growing up in Nepal, Sangita developed a strong connection with the country's mountains, culture, and hospitality. Therefore, she understands what international visitors expect when they travel to the Himalayas. Her warm personality and attention to detail help guests feel comfortable from the moment they arrive in Nepal.

Leadership and Management

As a co-founder, Sangita works closely with the management team to ensure smooth daily operations. She coordinates travel arrangements, responds to customer inquiries, and helps maintain the high service standards of Everpeak Adventure. In addition, she carefully reviews feedback from travelers to improve the overall experience.

Moreover, Sangita believes that excellent communication is essential for successful adventure travel. For this reason, she provides clear information about itineraries, accommodations, permits, transportation, and trekking preparations. Her organized approach helps travelers plan their trips with confidence.

Commitment to Customer Experience

Sangita is deeply committed to customer satisfaction. She understands that every traveler has different interests, fitness levels, and expectations. Therefore, she helps design personalized trekking and tour experiences that match each guest's needs.

Furthermore, she ensures that travelers receive prompt support before, during, and after their journey. Whether guests are trekking to Everest Base Camp, Annapurna Base Camp, Langtang Valley, or exploring Nepal's cultural destinations, Sangita works to make every trip comfortable and memorable.

Supporting Responsible Tourism

Sangita strongly supports responsible tourism and community-based travel. She believes that tourism should create positive benefits for local people while protecting Nepal's natural environment. Consequently, Everpeak Adventure works with local guides, porters, hotels, and community businesses whenever possible.

In addition, the company encourages respectful cultural interactions and environmentally friendly travel practices. This approach allows travelers to enjoy authentic experiences while contributing to local communities.

Looking Ahead

Today, Sangita Aryal continues to lead Everpeak Adventure with dedication, professionalism, and genuine care for travelers. Her goal is to provide exceptional service, build lasting relationships with guests, and share the beauty of Nepal with visitors from around the world. Finally, her passion for hospitality and adventure remains a key part of Everpeak Adventure's success.

item.title: Dipesh Aryal
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.content:encoded:
Dipesh Aryal – Founder & Managing Director of Everpeak Adventure

About Dipesh Aryal

Dipesh Aryal is the Founder and Managing Director of Everpeak Adventure, a trusted trekking and tour company based in Nepal. He established the company with a clear vision of providing safe, reliable, and unforgettable travel experiences. Since its beginning, Everpeak Adventure has focused on quality service, customer satisfaction, and responsible tourism.

Growing up in Nepal, Dipesh developed a deep appreciation for the Himalayas and the country's rich cultural heritage. Therefore, he decided to build a company that would introduce travelers from around the world to Nepal's natural beauty. His passion for adventure and hospitality continues to guide the company's mission today.

Vision and Leadership

As the Managing Director, Dipesh oversees every part of the company's operations. He works closely with the team to ensure every trek and tour is well organized. In addition, he carefully reviews itineraries, travel arrangements, and customer support to maintain high service standards.

Moreover, Dipesh believes that every traveler deserves honest information and personalized assistance. For this reason, Everpeak Adventure offers carefully planned trips that combine adventure, comfort, and local experiences. His leadership has helped the company build lasting relationships with travelers from many different countries.

Commitment to Quality

Under Dipesh's leadership, Everpeak Adventure offers a wide range of trekking and tour packages across Nepal. These include the Everest Base Camp Trek, Annapurna Base Camp Trek, Langtang Valley Trek, Manaslu Circuit Trek, and many other popular adventures.

Furthermore, safety is always the company's highest priority. Every itinerary is designed with careful planning and attention to detail. The team also works with experienced guides and local experts to provide professional service throughout every journey.

Promoting Responsible Tourism

Dipesh strongly supports responsible and sustainable tourism. He believes that travel should benefit both visitors and local communities. Therefore, Everpeak Adventure encourages respectful cultural experiences and environmentally friendly travel practices.

In addition, the company works with local guides, porters, and accommodation providers whenever possible. This approach helps support local families while giving travelers authentic experiences throughout Nepal.

Looking Ahead

Today, Dipesh Aryal continues to lead Everpeak Adventure with dedication and integrity. His goal is to inspire more people to explore the Himalayas with confidence. Finally, he remains committed to delivering exceptional service, creating unforgettable adventures, and sharing the beauty of Nepal with travelers from around the world.

item.title: Terms and Conditions
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.content:encoded:
Welcome to Ever Peak Adventure. By accessing our website, making an inquiry, or booking any of our services, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following Terms & Conditions. Please read them carefully before confirming your booking.

1. Booking & Confirmation

  • All bookings must be made through our website, email, or authorized representatives.

  • A booking is confirmed only after receipt of the required deposit or full payment.

  • Upon confirmation, clients will receive booking details, trip information, and payment confirmation.

2. Payments

  • A deposit is required to secure your booking. The remaining balance must be paid before trip commencement, unless otherwise agreed in writing.

  • All prices are quoted in USD (or equivalent) unless stated otherwise.

  • Any bank charges, transaction fees, or currency conversion fees are the responsibility of the client.

3. Cancellation & Refund Policy

  • Cancellation requests must be submitted in writing.

  • Refund amounts depend on the timing of cancellation and services already arranged (permits, accommodations, transportation, etc.).

  • Certain costs such as permits, flight tickets, and government fees are non-refundable.

  • No refunds will be issued for unused services, early departure, or voluntary trip termination.

4. Trip Changes & Itinerary Adjustments

  • Ever Peak Adventure reserves the right to modify itineraries due to weather conditions, safety concerns, political situations, natural disasters, or other unforeseen circumstances.

  • Changes are made in the best interest of client safety and overall experience.

  • No compensation will be provided for itinerary changes beyond our control.

5. Client Responsibilities

  • Clients must ensure they are physically and mentally fit for their chosen trip.

  • Accurate personal, medical, and travel information must be provided at the time of booking.

  • Clients are responsible for obtaining valid passports, visas, travel insurance, and required vaccinations.

  • Respect for local culture, customs, laws, and environmental guidelines is mandatory.

6. Travel Insurance

  • Comprehensive travel insurance covering medical emergencies, evacuation, trip cancellation, and high-altitude activities is mandatory for all participants.

  • Ever Peak Adventure is not responsible for any losses arising from inadequate insurance coverage.

7. Health, Safety & Risk Acknowledgement

  • Adventure travel involves inherent risks including injury, illness, altitude sickness, weather changes, and natural hazards.

  • By booking with Ever Peak Adventure, clients acknowledge and accept these risks.

  • Clients agree to follow the guidance of guides and staff at all times for safety reasons.

8. Use of Images & Media

  • Ever Peak Adventure may use photographs or videos taken during trips for promotional purposes.

  • If you do not wish your images to be used, please inform us in writing before or during the trip.

9. Liability Disclaimer

  • Ever Peak Adventure is not liable for delays, injuries, loss, damage, or expenses caused by events beyond our control, including but not limited to weather, natural disasters, strikes, or government actions.

  • Our liability is limited to the value of the services booked with us.

10. Third-Party Services

  • We work with trusted local partners for accommodations, transportation, and flights.

  • Ever Peak Adventure is not responsible for acts or omissions of third-party service providers.

11. Governing Law & Jurisdiction

  • These Terms & Conditions are governed by the laws of Nepal.

  • Any disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Nepali courts.

12. Changes to Terms & Conditions

  • Ever Peak Adventure reserves the right to update or modify these Terms & Conditions at any time.

  • Updates will be effective immediately upon publication on our website.

13. Contact Information

For questions regarding these Terms & Conditions, please contact:

Ever Peak Adventure
📧 Email: info@everpeakadventures.com
📍 Location: Nepal

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.content:encoded:
Ever Peak Adventure values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and safeguard your data when you visit our website, make inquiries, or book our services.

By using our website and services, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

  • Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number, nationality, passport details (when required for permits), and other details provided during inquiries or bookings.

  • Booking & Travel Information: Trip preferences, emergency contact details, and special requirements.

  • Payment Information: Limited payment-related details processed securely through trusted payment gateways (we do not store full card details).

  • Technical Information: IP address, browser type, device information, and website usage data through cookies.

2. How We Use Your Information

Your information is used to:

  • Respond to inquiries and provide requested services

  • Process bookings, permits, and travel arrangements

  • Communicate important trip updates and information

  • Improve our website, services, and customer experience

  • Comply with legal and regulatory requirements

We only collect information that is necessary for providing our services.

3. Information Sharing & Disclosure

Ever Peak Adventure does not sell, rent, or trade your personal information.

We may share your information only with:

  • Government authorities (for permits, visas, or legal requirements)

  • Trusted partners such as guides, hotels, transport providers, or insurance companies (only when necessary for your trip)

  • Payment processors for secure transactions

All third parties are required to protect your data and use it solely for service delivery.

4. Data Security

We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, misuse, loss, or disclosure. While no online system is completely secure, we continuously work to maintain strong data protection standards.

5. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

Our website may use cookies to:

  • Enhance user experience

  • Analyze website traffic and performance

  • Remember user preferences

You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings, though this may affect some website features.

6. Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Access your personal data

  • Request correction of inaccurate information

  • Request deletion of your data (subject to legal or operational requirements)

  • Withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time

To exercise these rights, please contact us directly.

7. External Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites. Ever Peak Adventure is not responsible for the privacy practices or content of external sites. We encourage users to review their privacy policies separately.

8. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in laws or services. Any updates will be posted on this page with immediate effect.

9. Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us:

Ever Peak Adventure
📧 Email: info@everpeakadventures.com
📍 Location: Nepal

item.title: Why Ever Peak Adventures
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.content:encoded:
Local Himalayan Experts
Founded and operated by experienced Nepali mountaineers and travel professionals, we bring deep local knowledge and firsthand mountain experience to every journey.

Safety Without Compromise
Your safety is our highest priority. We follow strict safety standards, provide professional guidance, proper acclimatization, and well-planned itineraries for a secure adventure.

Licensed & Trusted Company
Fully licensed by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of Nepal, and proud members of TAAN and NMA, we operate with transparency, professionalism, and ethical responsibility.

Personalized Adventures
Every traveler is unique. We design tailor-made itineraries to match your interests, schedule, fitness level, and adventure goals.

Experienced Guides & Strong Support Team
Our certified guides and support staff have more than a decade of hands-on experience leading treks and climbs across Nepal’s iconic regions.

Authentic Cultural Experiences
Go beyond the trails. We connect you with local communities, traditions, and lifestyles for a deeper Himalayan experience.

Responsible & Sustainable Tourism
We support local livelihoods, respect cultural heritage, and promote eco-friendly practices to protect the mountains we love.

Honest Service & Transparent Pricing
No hidden costs, no false promises—just clear communication, fair pricing, and reliable service from start to finish.

item.title: Responsible Travel
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.content:encoded:
Responsive Travel

Adventure with responsibility — for people, culture, and nature. Explore Higher. Feel Deeper

At Ever Peak Adventure, we believe that adventure and responsibility go hand in hand. Exploring the Himalayas is a privilege, and it comes with a duty to protect the natural environment, respect local communities, and preserve Nepal’s cultural heritage. Every journey we plan is designed with sustainability in mind, so your adventure leaves a positive impact on the places you visit.

We are committed to sustainable trekking and travel practices. Our itineraries are carefully crafted to minimize environmental impact, reduce waste, and protect fragile ecosystems. We encourage travelers to follow “Leave No Trace” principles, avoid single-use plastics, and respect wildlife habitats. By working with local accommodations, guides, and service providers, we ensure your travel supports the economic and social well-being of communities along the trails.

Cultural respect is at the heart of every journey we organize. Our guides help travelers understand local customs, traditions, and ethical behavior, creating opportunities for meaningful interaction with local communities. From visiting remote villages to experiencing local festivals, we aim to make your journey not only adventurous, but also enriching and respectful.

Safety and education go hand in hand with responsibility. Our team prepares travelers with high-altitude awareness, waste management guidance, and ethical trekking practices, so every participant becomes a responsible traveler. By promoting awareness and mindfulness, we inspire choices that benefit both people and the planet.

By choosing Ever Peak Adventure, you are not just exploring Nepal — you are joining a movement of responsible travelers who care for the environment, uplift local communities, and honor the traditions of the Himalayas. Together, we can ensure these breathtaking landscapes and vibrant cultures thrive for generations to come.

Our Responsible Commitments

  • ✓ Leave No Trace Reduce waste, avoid single-use plastics, and keep trails clean.
  • ✓ Support Local Communities Work with local guides, porters, and businesses to strengthen local livelihoods.
  • ✓ Respect Culture & Traditions Learn local customs and behave ethically during village and monastery visits.
  • ✓ Safety & Education High-altitude awareness, responsible trekking guidance, and mindful travel.
Ever Peak Adventure • Responsible Trekking & Travel Responsible Travel Promise

item.title: Message From Founder
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.content:encoded:
Message From Founder

Explore Higher. Feel Deeper. Estb • 2024

Dipesh Aryal

Founder • Ever Peak Adventures

Welcome to Ever Peak Adventures. I'm Dipesh Aryal, and trekking has been my life's work for the past 15 years. My journey in the Himalayas began from the ground level as a porter, later becoming a trekking guide, and eventually establishing Ever Peak Adventures to share authentic Himalayan experiences with travelers from around the world.

Having explored almost every trekking region of Nepal, I understand the mountains beyond the maps. From planning safe routes and logistics to creating memorable experiences, every journey is built on real field knowledge. Before founding this company, I had already helped more than 10,000 travelers discover the beauty of Nepal.

⭐ 15+ Years Experience 🏔️ Nepal Himalayan Expert 🥾 Porter → Guide → Founder 😊 10,000+ Happy Travelers

Ever Peak Adventures was founded in 2024 with a simple vision—to provide honest service, professional guidance, and unforgettable Himalayan adventures. Every trip we organize reflects our commitment to safety, responsible tourism, and personalized hospitality.

When you choose Ever Peak Adventures, you become part of our family. We promise clear communication, genuine care, and support from your very first inquiry until your safe return home.

Thank you for placing your trust in Ever Peak Adventures. I look forward to welcoming you to Nepal and helping you experience the Himalayas in the safest, most meaningful, and unforgettable way possible.

Dipesh Aryal Founder, Ever Peak Adventures dipesh@everpeakadventure.com

item.title: About Us
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.content:encoded:
About Ever Peak Adventures

+ + + +

Our Mission

Our Vision

Our Goals

Why Choose Us?

Local Expertise, Global Standards

Based in Nepal, we offer deep local knowledge combined with international service standards. Our experienced guides understand the mountains, culture, and terrain, ensuring a safe, authentic, and well-managed journey.

Licensed, Trusted, and Responsible

We are officially licensed by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of Nepal, and are proud members of TAAN and NMA. This guarantees legal operation, safety compliance, and ethical trekking practices.

Experienced & Professional Team

With over a decade of experience, our guides, leaders, and support staff are highly trained in mountain safety, altitude awareness, and first aid—giving you confidence at every step.

Customized Adventures

We don’t believe in one-size-fits-all itineraries. Every trip is carefully tailored to your interests, timeframe, fitness level, and adventure goals.

Safety First Approach

Your safety is our top priority. We use well-planned routes, quality equipment, emergency protocols, and continuous monitoring throughout your journey.

Honest Pricing & No Hidden Costs

We offer transparent pricing with clear inclusions. What you see is what you get—no surprises, no hidden charges.

Passion That Makes the Difference

We genuinely love what we do. Every trek, tour, and climb is handled with care, dedication, and pride—because your journey is our reputation.

Welcome To Ever Peak Adventures

Ever Peak Adventure is a trusted Nepal trekking company specializing in trekking, peak climbing, hiking, and customized Himalayan adventures. Our experienced local guides lead unforgettable journeys to Everest Base Camp, Annapurna Base Camp, Langtang Valley, Upper Mustang, Manaslu Circuit, and many other spectacular destinations across Nepal. We focus on safety, personalized service, and authentic mountain experiences for every traveler.

WHY CHOOSE US

Why Choose Ever Peak Adventures?

We combine years of Himalayan expertise, personalized service, and a passion for adventure to deliver safe, authentic, and unforgettable trekking experiences throughout Nepal.

🏔️

Experienced Local Experts

Our professional guides have years of experience leading treks across Nepal, ensuring every journey is safe, informative, and enjoyable.

🛡️

Safety First

From carefully planned itineraries to altitude awareness and emergency support, your safety is always our highest priority.

😊

Personalized Service

Every traveler is different. We tailor each adventure according to your fitness level, interests, and travel goals.

🌿

Responsible Tourism

We support local communities, respect nature, and promote sustainable travel practices to preserve Nepal's beautiful mountains.

⭐

Quality You Can Trust

Transparent pricing, excellent customer care, and carefully selected accommodations ensure an exceptional trekking experience.

❤️

Passion for Adventure

We don't simply organize treks—we create lifelong memories and meaningful Himalayan experiences you'll never forget.

item.title: The Ultimate Guide to Trekking in the Himalayas
item.dc:creator: kabita
item.content:encoded:
Nepal is often called the adventure capital of the world, and for good reason. With towering peaks, pristine valleys, and rich cultural heritage, trekking in the Himalayas is an experience unlike any other. Whether you’re a first-time trekker or an experienced mountaineer, Nepal offers trails that inspire awe, challenge your limits, and create lifelong memories.

Why Trek in the Himalayas?

Trekking in the Himalayas is more than just a physical journey—it’s a chance to connect with nature, experience local culture, and find personal fulfillment. Along the trails, you’ll witness breathtaking landscapes, from snow-capped peaks to lush forests and sparkling rivers. You’ll also pass through traditional villages, where locals welcome trekkers with warmth and hospitality.

Popular Trekking Routes

Nepal offers a variety of treks, each with its unique charm:

  • Everest Base Camp Trek – Experience the thrill of standing in the shadow of the world’s highest mountain.

  • Annapurna Circuit Trek – Diverse landscapes, from subtropical forests to alpine meadows, and rich cultural encounters.

  • Langtang Valley Trek – A less crowded trail with stunning valleys, glacial lakes, and traditional Tamang villages.

  • Ghorepani Poon Hill Trek – Ideal for a short trek with spectacular sunrise views over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges.

Preparation and Safety Tips

Trekking in the Himalayas requires proper preparation to ensure a safe and enjoyable experience:

  • Physical Fitness: Start training months in advance with cardio, hiking, and strength exercises.

  • Acclimatization: Take time to adjust to higher altitudes to prevent altitude sickness.

  • Gear: Invest in quality trekking shoes, clothing, and essentials like trekking poles and a sleeping bag.

  • Guides and Porters: Hiring experienced guides ensures safety, cultural insight, and smooth logistics.

  • Respect Local Culture: Follow local customs, dress modestly, and seek permission before taking photographs of locals.

Responsible Trekking

At Ever Peak Adventure, we prioritize responsible and sustainable travel. We encourage trekkers to minimize environmental impact, respect wildlife, and support local communities. Following “Leave No Trace” principles and using eco-friendly practices helps preserve these majestic landscapes for future generations.

Conclusion

Trekking in the Himalayas is not just a journey—it’s a life-changing experience. From spectacular mountain vistas to authentic cultural encounters, every step offers adventure and inspiration. With proper preparation, responsible practices, and guidance from experienced professionals like Ever Peak Adventure, your trek in Nepal can become a truly unforgettable adventure.
