item.title: Everest Base Camp with Island Peak
item.dc:creator: Everpeak
item.content:encoded:
Everest Base Camp with Island Peak Adventure

The Everest Base Camp with Island Peak adventure combines the iconic Everest Base Camp trek with the exciting challenge of climbing Island Peak (6,189 m/20,305 ft). This unforgettable Himalayan journey takes you through the beautiful Khumbu Valley, offering breathtaking mountain views, authentic Sherpa culture, ancient monasteries, and traditional mountain villages surrounded by some of the world’s highest peaks. Your adventure begins with a scenic flight to Lukla, followed by a classic trek through Phakding, Namche Bazaar, Tengboche, Dingboche, and Lobuche toward Everest Base Camp. Carefully planned acclimatization stops help your body adjust to the increasing altitude while you enjoy spectacular views of Mount Everest, Lhotse, Nuptse, Ama Dablam, Thamserku, and Kongde. After reaching Everest Base Camp, the journey continues to Kala Patthar (5,545 m), one of the best viewpoints in the region for sunrise and panoramic views of Mount Everest and the surrounding Himalayan peaks. The trek then heads toward Island Peak, where you will receive professional guidance and practical training in essential mountaineering skills before attempting the summit.

Island Peak Climbing and Summit Experience

The Everest Island Peak journey includes adequate acclimatization and preparation for the Island Peak summit. You will learn essential climbing techniques and use mountaineering equipment such as crampons, harnesses, ropes, and an ice axe under the guidance of experienced climbing professionals. Reaching the summit of Island Peak (6,189 m) is a rewarding achievement, with spectacular views of Mount Everest, Lhotse, Nuptse, Ama Dablam, Makalu, and Baruntse. Standing above the Khumbu Valley and surrounded by towering Himalayan peaks makes the summit experience an unforgettable highlight for adventurous trekkers and aspiring mountaineers. With an experienced local trekking and climbing team, carefully planned acclimatization, quality equipment, and personalized support, this trek is designed to provide a safe, professional, and memorable Himalayan adventure. It is an ideal choice for physically fit trekkers who want to experience the legendary Everest Base Camp trek while taking on the rewarding challenge of climbing a high-altitude Himalayan peak.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
• Summit Island Peak (6,189 m), one of Nepal's most popular trekking peaks.
  • Trek to the legendary Everest Base Camp (5,364 m).
  • Witness a breathtaking sunrise from Kala Patthar (5,545 m) with panoramic Everest views.
  • Experience the thrill of glacier travel and basic mountaineering with expert climbing guides.
  • Enjoy scenic mountain flights between Kathmandu and Lukla.
  • Explore the vibrant Sherpa capital of Namche Bazaar.
  • Visit the famous Tengboche Monastery, the spiritual heart of the Khumbu.
  • Walk through the spectacular Sagarmatha National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
  • Cross iconic Himalayan suspension bridges and trek through beautiful rhododendron and pine forests.
  • Admire magnificent views of **Mount Everest, Lhotse, Nuptse, Ama Dablam, Makalu, and many other Himalayan giants.
  • Stay in authentic Sherpa teahouses and experience warm Himalayan hospitality.
  • Celebrate your successful Island Peak summit with unforgettable views over the Everest region.

• Airport pick-up and drop-off by private vehicle.
  • 2 nights hotel accommodation in Kathmandu with breakfast.
  • Round-trip domestic flights: Kathmandu – Lukla – Kathmandu.
  • All airport transfers for domestic flights.
  • Standard teahouse accommodation during the trek.
  • Three meals a day (breakfast, lunch, and dinner) during the trek.
  • Seasonal fresh fruits after dinner during the trek.
  • Experienced, government-licensed English-speaking trekking guide.
  • Professional Island Peak climbing guide (Summit Guide).
  • Porter service (1 porter for every 2 trekkers; carries up to 20 kg).
  • Island Peak climbing permit.
  • Sagarmatha National Park entry permit.
  • Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality entrance permit.
  • TIMS card (if required by current regulations).
  • Group climbing equipment (fixed ropes, ice screws, snow bars, etc.).
  • Climbing gear support (rope, harness, helmet, crampons, ice axe, ascender, descender, carabiners) if included in your package.
  • One night accommodation at Island Peak Base Camp with meals.
  • Sleeping tent, dining tent, kitchen tent, mattress, and camping equipment at Base Camp.
  • Experienced cook and kitchen staff for the Base Camp.
  • Boiled drinking water at Island Peak Base Camp.
  • Comprehensive first aid kit carried by the guide.
  • Guide, climbing guide, porter, and staff salaries, insurance, meals, accommodation, and transportation.
  • Government taxes and company service charges.

• International airfare to/from Nepal.
  • Nepal entry visa fee.
  • Travel and high-altitude rescue insurance (mandatory).
  • Personal climbing equipment rental (boots, down jacket, sleeping bag, crampons, ice axe, harness, helmet, ascender, descender, trekking poles, etc.) unless stated as included.
  • Personal trekking gear and clothing.
  • Lunch and dinner in Kathmandu.
  • Personal expenses (laundry, Wi-Fi, hot shower, charging devices, snacks, drinks, tips, etc.).
  • Bottled water, soft drinks, alcoholic beverages, and extra beverages.
  • Porter for personal extra luggage beyond the package allowance.
  • Emergency evacuation, helicopter rescue, or medical expenses not covered by insurance.
  • Extra hotel nights in Kathmandu due to early arrival, late departure, or flight delays/cancellations.
  • Costs arising from itinerary changes caused by weather, natural disasters, strikes, or other unforeseen events.
  • Tips for guides, climbing guides, porters, and support staff (expected but optional).
  • Any services not specifically mentioned under Package Includes.

• Peak Season Flight Note: During high season (March–May & October–November), fixed-wing flights to Lukla operate out of Manthali Airport in Ramechhap. If flying during these months, you will leave Kathmandu by road around 1:30 AM (a 4–5 hour drive) to catch an early morning flight from Ramechhap to Lukla. Outside peak months, flights depart directly from Kathmandu.
